calibration.method: One shared sheet body reference transferred from the fixed first-sheet neutral by reviewed median head/body width; never per-pose bbox height fitting
calibration.notes: First-sheet neutral reference only, [150,39,481,576] main anatomy537 high with original adopted-canonical convention. Per-sheet front-head width medians transfer scale once. Pond head projection is explicitly a scale proxy, not individual standing/air/land bbox fitting. Seated sheet has different native dimensions1312x1199 and larger362 head width; one shared586.4 reference protects seated body scale. Accepted old neutral is never replaced.
